heroTitle: Ancient Egyptian Mythology & The Book of the Dead
extracted_lists: Carnelian: Red stone linked to blood, life force, and protection; common in amulets
Faience: Blue-green glazed ceramic associated with rebirth, fertility, and joy
Gold: Imperishable metal of the gods; flesh of deities; solar associations
Natron: Purifying salt used in mummification and cleansing rituals
Honey: Preservative and offering to gods; used in medical-magical treatments
Milk: Nourishing substance; used in healing spells and offerings to Hathor
Papyrus: Sacred plant; writing surface imbued with creative power
Greek Magical Papyri: Greco-Egyptian magical synthesis incorporating heka techniques
Hermetic Tradition: Western esotericism claiming Egyptian origins through Hermes Trismegistus
Coptic Magical Texts: Christianized Egyptian magic preserving earlier techniques
Arabic/Islamic Magic: Medieval traditions inheriting Egyptian concepts through Alexandria
Babylonian Magic: Contemporary Near Eastern tradition with some parallel techniques
Jewish Practical Kabbalah: Divine names, amulets, and words of power showing possible Egyptian influence
name: Egyptian Mythology

metadata.lastUpdateReason: Added type field and expanded description

description: Ancient Egyptian mythology featuring gods like Ra, Osiris, and Isis, with elaborate afterlife beliefs, mummification practices, and divine kingship spanning 3000+ years.
extracted_headings: The Opening of the Mouth Ceremony
longDescription: Delve into ancient Egypt's mysteries. From Ra's solar journey to Osiris's resurrection, explore the wisdom of the pharaohs and the secrets of the pyramids.
